statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmias
The service is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data over an extended period
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying cardiac electrical activity
The patient's symptoms are coded as R00.2
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
